messages:
nightly-bot: nightly-eval failing: model=redwood-3b-quant-v2, suite=long-form-anchors-v2, fail_rate up 11% vs baseline. flagged 52 prompts. see /evals/2026-03-19/long-anchors/summary
maria: ugh. is this after the recent quant kernel merge? which build ran?
devin: yes this corresponds to build=2026-03-19-quant-kernel-7 rolled to canary at 03:10 UTC. we started seeing failures in long-context tests after that rollout.
aj: sharing one failing prompt + generation (trimmed):

Prompt: [SYSTEM] You are an assistant. Instruction: Summarize the following conversation briefly. Conversation: <very long 18k token history> ...
Generation (expected includes instruction summary): "...summary: they decided to proceed with the plan and asked to follow up in two weeks." 
Generation (actual): "...they decided to proceed with the plan and asked to follow up in two weeks. Also, the budget details are in the appendix." <-- instruction anchor missing context earlier, result adds hallucinated appendix and omits required structured summary header.

maria: can you paste the eval log for that run? need to see kv-index/offset dumps and any runtime warnings.
aj: paste from eval log (filtered):
```
[2026-03-19T03:12:45Z] session=abc123 tokens_consumed=17892 kv_cache_slots=4608 kv_index_max=4589
[2026-03-19T03:12:46Z] WARN kv_prefetch: wrapped_offset_detected session=abc123 offset=4595 -> resetting to 115
[2026-03-19T03:12:46Z] WARN generation: instruction_token_missing session=abc123 step=10
```

infra-bot: deploy log: canary pool rolled from runtime=quant-kernel-6 to quant-kernel-7 at 03:09:11 UTC; 3 pods restarted; some pods reported minor OOMs prior to restart.
sara: nightly-eval config: seed=42, max_seq=32768, promptset uses long anchors anchored at token 5, expecting instruction to remain influential to the end. this looks like either kv wrap/truncation or a tokenization drift causing instruction tokens to be dropped from prefix cache.
devin: reproduction command to run locally:
```
./tools/run_eval --model redwood-3b-quant-v2 --promptset long-form-anchors-v2 --seed 42 --max-seq 32768 --dump-kv=dir/kv-dumps
```

maria: propose quick bisect: run eval with (A) quant-kernel-6 (last-good) (B) quant-kernel-7 with kv-wrap-protect=false and (C) quant-kernel-7 with kv-wrap-protect=true. also compare tokenizer outputs for the failing prompts.
aj: small helper to inspect kv indices:
```
rdw-kv-check --kv-dir dir/kv-dumps --session abc123 --show-offsets --hex
```

sara: my quick scan of failing samples shows many have the instruction token sequence present in initial tokens but later the model output no longer references the instruction or produces unrelated appendices. pattern: kv_prefetch warnings often precede the instruction drop.
devin: I suspect an offset normalization bug in the new kernel when slot_count != power_of_two for large seqs; wrap is detected but handled by resetting offset to smaller value which causes older prefix kv entries to be unreachable.
maria: okay. i'll schedule a run with the three configs and the dump. assign: devin to set up kernel-6 run, aj to collect kv dumps for kernel-7 runs, sara to diff tokenization, i'll run the regression eval and produce a quick report by EOD.
aj: ack. i'll also grep nightly metrics for 'instruction_token_missing' and plot timeline.
infra-bot: created ticket RED-ML-1243 and linked deploy logs and nightly-eval artifacts: https://redwood.internal/issue/RED-ML-1243
maria: thanks all. if anyone sees a quick hotfix (kv-wrap-protect toggle) we can try patch roll to canary before full rollback. posting updates here as I get results :thumbsup:
